item.title: Kerrygold Brings Milk & Magic Christmas Fest to Lagos This December
item.description: Christmas is a time for making memories, sharing special moments and enjoying the little things that make the season memorable. This December, Kerrygold is bringing some extra magic to the festive season with its Milk & Magic Christmas Fest , a free family-friendly celebration of food, fun and togetherness. Scheduled for Saturday, 5 December 2026, at Ikeja City Mall, Lagos, the festival promises a day filled with exciting activities and festive experiences for children and adults alike. Families can look forward to a fun-filled day out, with free admission upon registration, making it a lovely opportunity to step away from their usual routines and create special memories together. From exciting games and interactive activities to the much-loved Santa’s Grotto, there will be plenty to keep guests entertained. Children can look forward to the magic and excitement of the season, while parents get to enjoy the experience alongside them. And, of course, no celebration would be complete without a little indulgence. Guests can also look forward to delicious milk treats from Kerrygold, adding a taste of the brand to the day’s festivities. Beyond the fun and entertainment, Milk & Magic Christmas Fest reflects Kerrygold’s commitment to creating meaningful connections with consumers beyond the products they enjoy every day. By bringing families together in a relaxed and engaging setting, the festival offers an opportunity to experience the brand in a different way, while celebrating the simple pleasures of good food and shared moments. With its distinctive rich, creamy taste and proud Irish dairy heritage, Kerrygold continues to bring quality dairy experiences closer to Nigerian consumers. Through its products and consumer engagement initiatives, the brand remains focused on creating experiences that resonate with its consumers and bring people together. As the countdown to Christmas begins, Milk & Magic Christmas Fest promises a lovely opportunity for families to share in the excitement of the season, enjoy some festive treats and make memories that will last beyond the holidays. Would you love to enjoy this festive experience with your family? Admission is FREE, but registration is required and spaces are limited. Visit https://milkandmagicfest.com/ to register now! item.title: It must be fully investigated: Feijóo firm on the Negreira case 🤨
item.description: It must be fully investigated: Feijóo firm on the Negreira case 🤨 People’s Party leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo appeared on El Chiringuito last night and did not shy away from any of Spanish football’s controversies. From demanding firm action over the Negreira case to showering Lamine Yamal with praise and revealing his nickname for Florentino Pérez, the politician made several headline-grabbing remarks. A firm stance on the Negreira case and a nod to Florentino Asked about the refereeing investigation embroiling FC Barcelona, Feijóo was unequivocal, calling for every trace of suspicion to be removed from the competition. "Cheating must be detected and rooted out of any competition. This is serious and must be investigated thoroughly," he declared. There was also time to discuss his ties with Real Madrid’s leadership. The People’s Party leader acknowledged that he has a "cordial relationship" with the club’s president, whom he has known "for a very long time" and affectionately calls 'Floro'. Full of praise for Lamine Yamal and nostalgic for Real Madrid Despite his close ties to Real Madrid circles, Feijóo did not hesitate to applaud the talent of their arch-rivals’ biggest star. Speaking about Lamine Yamal, he described the Barcelona winger as "pure inspiration, constant instinct, youthful yet mature and incredibly well-rounded", even comparing him to a global legend: "If he keeps this up, he could become Spanish football’s Maradona". Finally, he delved into his football memories to recall the players who shaped his youth, with a distinctly Real Madrid flavour: "My childhood idols were the players of my era... Pirri, Camacho, Santillana and Buyo". This article was translated into English by Artificial Intelligence. You can read the original version in 🇪🇸 here.

item.title: Iyabo Ojo apologises over viral handshake video
item.description: Nollywood actress, Iyabo Ojo, has apologised following a viral video showing a man appearing to decline her handshake at an event, explaining that she was unaware he was a traditional ruler. The actress addressed the controversy in a statement posted on her Instagram page, saying she had approached the table after being informed that some people seated there had sent greetings to her. Ojo said she recognised HRM Oloto, whom she described as her brother, and assumed the other people at the table were his friends. “I was sitting pretty when someone came to tell me they sent their greetings from that table. When I looked in that direction and saw HRM Oloto, I said, ‘Ah, okay, that’s my brother, let me go greet him,’” she said. “Honestly, I am very sorry if I caused any offence. I meant no disrespect to his throne and culture. Henceforth, I will be very mindful,” she stated. Ojo also acknowledged that she was accustomed to greeting people with handshakes and hugs, noting that she had been making efforts to change the habit. “We learn every day. I meant no disrespect. It’s all love from this side,” she added. The post Iyabo Ojo apologises over viral handshake video appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 🥐 Euro hangover, new contracts: Thursday's 5️⃣ stories

The Yellow Submarine comfortably beat Slavia Praha , while Atlético and Barça did the same against Viking and Sabah , respectively, rounding off a perfect matchday for LaLiga in Europe's premier club competition. European giants suffer major setbacks Not everyone enjoyed a comfortable night in Europe. The surprise came in France, with Bayern Munich losing at home to Lille (2-1). PSG could only draw, dropping points at the Parc des Princes against Roma (2-2), as did Manchester United , held in Lisbon by Sporting CP (2-2). Real Madrid secure Valverde and Brahim's futures On the transfer front, the offices at Valdebebas are buzzing. Real Madrid are expected to officially announce contract extensions for Federico Valverde and Brahim Díaz today or tomorrow. Both players will extend their stays with the club for several more seasons, securing the squad's present and future. Thursday tests in the Europa and Conference Leagues The continental action continues, with attention turning today to Europe's second- and third-tier competitions and three key fixtures. item.title: FPL Gameweek 12 Differential Picks: Best Low-Owned Players
item.description: HULL, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 22: Oliver McBurnie of Hull City celebrates scoring his team’s first goal during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Hull City and Brighton & Hove Albion at MKM Stadium on November 22, 2026 in Hull, England. (Photo by George Wood/Getty Images) | Getty Images Staying ahead of friends and rivals in Fantasy Premier League is not always easy, especially when many managers have the same popular players in their teams. One way to gain ground is to find players who are being overlooked. When a low-owned player delivers a big points return, managers who picked him can get an advantage over those who missed out. However, having low ownership does not automatically make someone a good pick. It is also important to look at how often a player starts, how he has been performing and the fixtures coming up before bringing him into your team. With that in mind, here are some players owned by fewer than 5% of managers who could be worth considering for FPL Gameweek 12 . 1. James Hill – Bournemouth Position: Defender Price: £5.7m Ownership: 4.6% GW12 Fixture: Fulham (A) Hill has been one of Bournemouth’s best defensive options this season, collecting 56 FPL points and keeping four clean sheets. His recent performances have also been encouraging, with 42 points across his last five Gameweeks. The 24-year-old has played regularly for Bournemouth, making him an appealing option for managers who prefer defenders they can rely on to start. His next match is against Fulham at Craven Cottage, followed by a home fixture against Brighton & Hove Albion 2. Enzo Le Fee – Sunderland Position: Midfielder Price: £5.7m Ownership: 3.1% GW12 Fixture: Tottenham Hotspur (H) Sunderland have benefited from Le Fee’s work in midfield, with the Frenchman collecting 49 points this season. He has also recorded 3.90 expected goal involvements , showing his ability to get into promising positions in front of goal. That figure makes him an interesting option for managers looking beyond the usual midfield choices. His ability to create chances and contribute further up the pitch gives him added appeal. However, Sunderland face Tottenham Hotspur at home before travelling to Liverpool , so managers should consider the difficulty of those fixtures before bringing him in. 3. James Justin – Leeds United Position : Defender Price: £4.5m Ownership: 2.7% Gameweek 12 fixture: Coventry City (H) Justin could be a useful addition for managers looking to save money in defence without sacrificing regular playing time. The Leeds United defender has started all 11 of their Premier League matches this season, showing how important he has become to the team. He has also scored once and provided an assist, giving him some attacking potential alongside his defensive contributions. Leeds United have kept clean sheets against Tottenham Hotspur and Crystal Palace in recent weeks, while their 4-1 win over Chelsea should give them confidence heading into the home meeting with Coventry City

One side keeps finding the net at home but can’t stop conceding, while the other has forgotten how to win and arrives straight from a midweek European trip. Here’s everything you need before kick-off: both sides’ form, the head-to-head record, the latest team news, how to watch in the UK and US, and our score prediction. Their last five read: a 3-2 defeat at Manchester City, a 1-1 home draw with Nottingham Forest, a 2-2 draw at Hull, a 2-1 home defeat to Bournemouth and a 2-0 loss at Tottenham last weekend. They have conceded 21 goals in those last 10 league games. Portman Road at least brings goals. Ipswich have scored in each of their last four home matches, and they have seven points from five home league games, with six scored and seven conceded. Away from home they have just four points from six games and have conceded 15. Julio Enciso has been their standout player, with two goals, two assists and a 7.12 FotMob rating. Exequiel Palacios (7.09) and Saša Lukić (7.07) have anchored the midfield, Abdoul Ouattara has two assists and Emersonn has two goals. Up front, Zian Flemming averages 2.2 shots on target per match, the best rate at the club. Aston Villa are 12th with 14 points from 11 games (W3 D5 L3), having scored 14 and conceded 17. Unai Emery has won 27% of his league games this season, averaging 1.3 points per game, a big drop for a side playing Champions League football. Villa are winless in five matches and have drawn three straight Premier League games for the first time since 2014: 1-1 at home to Fulham, 4-4 at Manchester United and 0-0 at home to Sunderland last weekend. In the Champions League they lost 3-0 at Barcelona and 1-0 at Galatasaray on Tuesday. They have scored just five goals in their last five matches, blanking in two. Their away form tells a mixed story. Villa have eight points from five away league games, scoring eight and conceding 10, and they have scored eight goals in their last three Premier League away matches. item.title: Manchester United vs Brentford Score Prediction, Injury News & Head-to-Head Record
item.description: LIVERPOOL, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 22: Mauricio Pochettino, Manager of Manchester United, reacts before during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Liverpool FC and Manchester United at Anfield on November 22, 2026 in Liverpool, England. (Photo by Michael Regan/Getty Images) | Getty Images Mauricio Pochettino takes charge of his first game at Old Trafford, and he could hardly have picked a tougher moment. Manchester United are in a deep hole, and the visitors are a Brentford side that has been far more comfortable at home than on the road. Here’s everything you need before Saturday’s kick-off: both sides’ form, the head-to-head record, the latest team news, how to watch in the UK and US, and our score prediction. Michael Carrick won 10% of his league games before being replaced by Pochettino. The form is grim. item.title: US lists 63 professions eligible for 3-year work visa
item.description: The US has outlined 63 professional categories whose qualified practitioners can apply for a temporary work visa allowing them to take up employment in the country for up to three years. The arrangement, known as the Trade National (TN) visa, is available exclusively to citizens of Canada and Mexico under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA). The TN visa allows eligible professionals from the two neighbouring countries to work for US employers in specified occupations, provided they meet the educational, professional and employment requirements attached to their chosen fields. According to the US Department of State, applicants must be citizens of either Canada or Mexico, have a profession recognised under the USMCA list, secure a prearranged job with a US employer and possess the qualifications required for the position. The list covers several professional sectors, including healthcare, engineering, science, education, accounting and other specialised occupations. Some of the professions recognised under the arrangement include accountants, architects, engineers, lawyers, pharmacists, registered nurses, dentists, veterinarians, economists, mathematicians, scientists, university lecturers and computer systems analysts. Other eligible occupations include agriculturalists, biologists, chemists, geologists, meteorologists, psychologists, social workers, urban planners and technical publications writers. However, appearing on the list does not automatically guarantee approval, as applicants must demonstrate that they satisfy the specific educational or professional requirements for their occupations. Most of the listed professions require a bachelor’s degree or its equivalent, although some categories permit alternative qualifications or professional credentials. The US government also requires applicants to provide details of their proposed employment, including their job responsibilities, expected duration of stay, qualifications and remuneration arrangements. Under Section 214.6 of Title 8 of the US Code of Federal Regulations, successful TN applicants can be admitted into the country for a period not exceeding three years. The classification can also be extended, subject to the applicant continuing to meet the relevant requirements. The application process differs slightly between the two eligible nationalities. Canadian citizens can generally apply for TN status at a US port of entry or designated pre-clearance facility without first obtaining a TN visa from a US embassy. Mexican citizens, however, must obtain a TN nonimmigrant visa from a US embassy or consulate before seeking admission into the country. The arrangement was originally introduced under the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), which came into force in 1994. It was retained when the USMCA replaced NAFTA on July 1, 2020. item.title: Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua full fight card announced
item.description: The full fight card for Tyson Fury (36-2-1, 25 KOs) vs. Anthony Joshua (30-4, 27 KOs) has been formally announced. The announcement was made on Wednesday over social media . Fight fans around the world will be able to watch those bouts on The Ring magazine’s social media accounts and Netflix’s TikTok. Fury vs. Joshua headlines a Dec. 11 card promoted by Queensberry Promotions, Matchroom Boxing, and Sela. Fight fans around the world will be able to catch that bout and three other undercard clashes live on Netflix. Tyson Fury vs. Anthony Joshua full fight card Fight fans may already be familiar with some of the bouts that are scheduled to take place on this card. The undercard that will be broadcast on Netflix consists of three heavyweight clashes. Deontay Wilder (45-4-1, 43 KOs) is set to take on Martin Bakole (21-2-1, 16 KOs). Moses Jolly (12-0-1, 8 KOs) takes on Igor Macedo (15-1, 14 KOs) while Da’Mazion Vanhouter (14-0, 11 KOs) faces Michael Essomba (11-2, 10 KOs). Below are the fights that will be on broadcast on social media: Joe Cordina vs. Mauricio Lara, lightweight Hayato Tsutsumi vs. Vic Pasillas, featherweight Reito Tsutsumi vs. Muheeb Fazeldin, super featherweight Constantino Nanga vs. Lerrone Richards, light heavyweight Mikie Tallon vs. Sean Bruce, super flyweight Mohammed Alakel vs. Rogger Rivera, super featherweight Odel Kamara vs. Patrik Matejcek, super welterweight Roman Fury vs. Adam Kolarik, heavyweight Mark Robinson/Goldstar Promotions The Big Fight Weekend verdict One fight that stands out among the eight that were announced on Wednesday is the one between Cordina and Lara. Both are former world champions and relatively better known than many of the other fighters on the undercard. There is also the clash between Tsutsumi and Pasillas, a fight that sees a talented youngster take on a veteran of the sport. Tallon takes a step up in opposition against Bruce, a former British flyweight champion. With all that being said, it feels like quantity has been valued over quality when it comes to this fight card. Fazeldin spent nearly six years out of the ring before returning earlier this year and yet finds himself facing someone like Tsutsumi. Alakel will be having his tenth bout as a professional, yet takes on an opponent who is 3-7 while Roman Fury faces a 10-12 fighter. It really does seem like the organizers put more care in making Fury vs. Joshua happen and neglected to put competitive fights on the undercard. On Dec. 11, fight fans can only hope that the bouts are more competitive than they look. item.title: ‘We will find a way to win’ insists Pochettino after rocky Man Utd start
item.description: New Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino insisted his team would find a way to win games after a tricky start to life at the helm of the Red Devils. United were held to a chaotic 2-2 Champions League draw at Sporting Lisbon on Wednesday, after a 4-0 thrashing by rivals Liverpool in his first match on Sunday. Man United, 19th in the Premier League, were upset with several refereeing decisions across both matches, but Pochettino said his team had to take responsibility for their situation. “I’m happy to be here,” said Pochettino, when asked about the various decisions that had gone against his team in his first week in charge. “We are here to take responsibility… we are going for sure to improve and to put that team in the place that, because of their history, we deserve to be. “Nothing is easy but we have the energy and I think we have the capacity, and most importantly the players and the power and the energy from our fans that is massive and I think united, all together, I think we will find a way to perform and win games.” United had two goals controversially ruled out against Sporting, but might have won the game were it not for a mistake from goalkeeper Senne Lammens. The Belgian dropped the ball for Colombian striker Luis Suarez to score his second goal of the night, cancelling out Bruno Fernandes’s double against his old side. Lammens also saved a Suarez penalty and then gave away a second penalty, this time scored by the striker. “This type of thing happens, that is football,” said Pochettino. “Football is about making mistakes — I’m going to support always my player if something happens.” The Argentine said Man United’s defenders might have done better to help protect Lammens before he spilled the ball. “When you are a ‘keeper, it’s not easy, that ball. And always you need help from your teammates,” added Pochettino. “But of course, we need to accept, we accept the challenge and we are here to try to improve in all the small details that for sure we will improve.” The post ‘We will find a way to win’ insists Pochettino after rocky Man Utd start appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Leeds vs Coventry Score Prediction, Injury News & Head-to-Head Record
item.description: COVENTRY, ENGLAND - NOVEMBER 21: Frank Lampard, Manager of Coventry City, celebrates after the Premier League 2026/27 match between Coventry City and Crystal Palace FC at The Coventry Building Society Arena on November 21, 2026 in Coventry, England. (Photo by Gareth Copley/Getty Images) | Getty Images Leeds United return to Elland Road on a high after one of their best results of the season, and they welcome a Coventry City side that has been far more dangerous at home than on the road. One team is eyeing the European places; the other is trying to keep a gap between themselves and the bottom three. Here’s everything you need before Saturday’s kick-off: both sides’ form, the head-to-head record, the latest team news, how to watch in the UK and US, and our score prediction. Match Preview Leeds sit seventh in the Premier League with 17 points from 11 games (W4 D5 L2). They are level on points with sixth-placed Brentford, one point behind Bournemouth in fifth and four off the top four. Daniel Farke’s side have been hard to beat all season, and with nine goals conceded they share the second-best defensive record in the league with Brighton, behind only Arsenal. Leeds arrive in form after back-to-back wins. Their last five league games read: a 1-1 home draw with Manchester United, a 0-0 draw at Sunderland, a 2-0 defeat at Bournemouth, a 1-0 home win over Tottenham and a 4-1 win at Chelsea last weekend. They have drawn five of their last 10 Premier League matches, so turning draws into wins has been their main challenge. Elland Road has been a fortress. Leeds are unbeaten in five home league games this season (W2 D3), scoring seven and conceding just three. That makes their home defence one of the tightest in the division. Away from home they have eight points from six games, with seven goals scored and six conceded. Dominic Calvert-Lewin leads the scoring with five goals, although that is slightly below his 5.77 xG, and he has a 7.11 FotMob rating. Noah Okafor has four goals in 10 appearances, including a brace at Chelsea. Behind them, goalkeeper James Trafford (7.43), James Justin (7.40) and Tarik Muharemović (7.32, two assists) are the side’s three highest-rated players. Leeds’ issue is output: 14 goals in 11 games is modest for a side chasing Europe. Coventry are 14th with 12 points from 11 games. Their record is all or nothing: four wins, no draws and seven defeats, with 13 goals scored and 21 conceded. They sit three points clear of 18th-placed Sunderland. Frank Lampard has won 36% of his league games this season, averaging 1.1 points per game. Their form has see-sawed. In their last five league games Coventry lost 3-1 at Tottenham and 1-0 at home to Fulham, beat Sunderland 3-1, lost 3-1 at Everton and then beat Crystal Palace 3-2 last weekend. item.title: ‘I talked to him’ – Andoni Iraola shares injury update on Victor Munoz after Brugge ‘pain’
item.description: ‘I talked to him’ – Andoni Iraola shares injury update on Victor Munoz after Brugge ‘pain’ Andoni Iraola has shared an update on the injury sustained by Victor Munoz in Liverpool’s win over Club Brugge on Wednesday night. The only blemish on a terrific result for the Reds in Belgium was the sight of the Spanish winger hobbling off towards the end of the first half, appearing to hurt his knee when overstretching to try and keep the ball after a surging run into the hosts’ penalty area. A stretcher had been readied for the 23-year-old, but he was at least able to pick himself up off the ground and leave the pitch flanked by medical staff. Iraola shares ‘optimistic’ injury update on Munoz Speaking to reporters after the match, Iraola gave an update on Munoz’s injury, with Liverpool’s number 23 due to go for an assessment to verify the seriousness of the issue. The Reds’ head coach said (via liverpoolfc.com ): “It is the worst part of the game, definitely. He was in a lot of pain when he left the pitch. He was a lot more positive when the game had finished. “It has been a knock on the knee, so now we have to assess him. Then if he presents well tomorrow and it’s just this knock… but obviously it’s very early to tell if there is something more than the knock. “In the moment it was very, very painful. After the game, I talked to him and he was a little bit more optimistic.” (Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images) Want more Empire of the Kop coverage? Add us as a preferred source on Google to your favourites list for news you can trust Fingers crossed for good news on Munoz The initial signs from Munoz certainly weren’t good, with the winger on the ground for a few minutes before managing to pick himself up, but this update from Iraola at least paints a slightly better picture for now. We still have to wait for the outcome of the assessment that he’s due to undergo today before we know how severe the injury is, and how long he’s expected to be out of action. We can only hope that it isn’t a serious setback for the 23-year-old, who’s looked bright and effervescent in his performances for Liverpool so far and was rewarded with a rare start last night before the unfortunate body blow. Munoz had been playing well in Brugge, too, with Liverpool Echo reporter Ian Doyle noting how the Spaniard offered a ‘real threat with his pace and a regular outlet down the right’ until he was forced off in the 42nd minute. Fingers crossed for good news on the winger once the medical assessment is completed.

item.title: Eight Bills players are closing in on hefty contract bonuses
item.description: It's the time in the NFL season to start looking at which Buffalo Bills could get some extra cash in their wallets. A handful of players could qualify for contract bonuses when Buffalo hosts the Kansas City Chiefs at 8:20 p.m. on Thanksgiving. Here's a list of Bills chasing incentive bonuses, according to Spotrac, a database that tracks player salaries and team payrolls for major professional sports leagues. Bills' Greg Rousseau has money on the table First, I need to admit I was wrong when I wrote it in a blog item for the Dolphins game that outside linebacker Greg Rousseau had earned a $1 million payday. Rousseau, who has 10 sacks this season, has only qualified for $500,000. He needs two more sacks to qualify for another $500,000. Safety Amani Hooker chasing $250K Safety Amani Hooker , who was traded Nov. 10 to the Buffalo Bills by the Tennessee Titans for a 2027 second-round pick, could earn a $250,000 incentive with one more interception. Hooker already has five picks this season. RB Ty Johnson eyeing a payday Third-down running back Ty Johnson , who gets paid $15,000 for every game he's active, could see an extra $125,000 if he reaches 300 receiving yards this season. He needs 31 more yards to get there. If he hits 500 receiving yards, he'll get another $125,000. Tyler Bass kicking for $1 million Bills bonus Kicker Tyler Bass , who has been really good this season, needs 14 more points to qualify for a $250,000 bonus at 115 kicking points. If he hits 125 points, he gets another $100,000. At 135, he earns another $150,000. Bass is also on track for a $500,000 bonus if he finishes the season with a 90% field goal percentage. He's currently at 96%. Alec Anderson zeroing in on $500,000 bonus Guard/tackle Alec Anderson , who has become a regular starter this season, has played 87% of offensive plays for the Bills. As long as he doesn't slip below 70% during the season, he gets an extra $400,000. If he gets it above 90%, it becomes a $500,000 bonus. Bradley Chubb is dreaming of a $3M payday Outside linebacker Bradley Chubb is chasing the most lucrative bonuses of any Bill, with a potential $3 million payout. If Chubb manages to play in 72% defensive snaps and the Bills qualify for the playoffs, he gets a $1 million bonus. He and the Bills have some work to do on that front. Chubb's played 68.7% of the snaps and the earliest Buffalo can wrap up the AFC East is Week 13, when they play the 5-5 New England Patriots. Chubb is a longshot for qualifying for another $2 million in incentives tied to sacks. Chubb, who has 1.5 sacks, needs to hit eight to get $250,000, 10 for another $750,000 and 12 for the final $1 million. item.title: Chiefs hold edge over Bills in one area that could prove telling
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs hold an edge over the Buffalo Bills in one key area as the two teams get set for their titanic Thanksgiving game. The Chiefs come into the game as one of the least penalized teams through 11 weeks of play. Kansas City players have been flagged just 64 times this season, with the majority of penalties (offensive holding) meant to protect quarterback Patrick Mahomes. That's good enough to rank Kansas City 28th in the NFL for penalties, with only four teams flagged fewer times.. The Bills are among the most flagged teams (6th) with 83 penalties. Buffalo ranks 2nd in the league and are first in defensive holding calls. Head coach Joe Brady has said he wants to reduce pre-snap penalties. "The pre-snap penalties, it's embarrassing," Brady said last week after a Jets game that saw nine pre-snap penalties with seven accepted. The Bills have been flagged 18 times for false starts; the Chiefs have been flagged just four times. Yes, the Bills are 9-1 on the season, but against the 8-2 Chiefs, giving Kansas City an advantage could prove costly. Bill Wolcott is a producer who helps cover the Buffalo Bills , high school and Rochester sports in general. The lifelong New Yorker has been a journalist for 32 years. This article originally appeared on Rochester Democrat and Chronicle: Chiefs hold edge over Bills in one area that could prove telling

item.title: The Bills’ wild Thanksgiving history goes back more than 60 years
item.description: When the Buffalo Bills host the Kansas City Chiefs on Thanksgiving Night, it will be their 12th appearance on America’s favorite football holiday and just their seventh since the 1970 AFL-NFL merger. During their heyday in the American Football League, the Bills were a fixture on the Thanksgiving football smorgasbord as they played five times in a span of eight years, more than any other AFL team. But after being largely ignored for about a half century - the Bills are back to being the darlings of Thanksgiving as this will be their fourth appearance in the last seven years. While the Lions and Dallas Cowboys have hosted Thanksgiving Day NFL games on an almost yearly basis, Detroit since 1934, Dallas since 1966, there was no designated franchise that played host to a Thanksgiving game during the 10-year lifespan of the AFL between 1960-69. There were 13 turkey day games played in the AFL and they were hosted by the Kansas City Chiefs (3), San Diego Chargers (3), Oakland Raiders (2), New York Titans (2), Denver Broncos (2), and Houston Oilers (1). The league wasn’t interested in playing a national game at Buffalo’s decrepit War Memorial Stadium, especially in late November, but it was fine with scheduling the Bills as the road team against New York in 1961, San Diego in 1964 and 1965, and Oakland in 1966 and 1968. Until this recent run of games, the only three times the Bills had played on Thanksgiving since the merger, they were again on the road, beating St. Louis in 1975 and losing to Detroit in 1976 and 1994. Here is a summary of the 11 previous Bills’ Thanksgiving Day games: Nov. 23, 1961 — Titans 21, Bills 14 Not a good day for the Bills’ offensive line which allowed 10 sacks for a total of 78 yards, the last coming in the final seconds with Buffalo facing fourth-and-goal from the New York 9. Quarterback M.C. Reynolds, subbing in for beleaguered Johnny Green who had suffered seven of the sacks, drove the Bills from their 20, but he threw three straight incomplete passes prior to getting sacked by Ed Cooke to end the game. “I was disturbed by the effort we made, particularly on offense,” said coach Buster Ramsey, whose team fell to 5-7 and last place in the East. “Our defense did a fairly good job stopping their running game, but again, we beat ourselves with mistakes in key situations.” The Bills would finish 6-8 and Ramsey was fired after just two seasons at the helm, soon to be replaced by Lou Saban. Nov. 26, 1964 — Bills 27, Chargers 24 Eleven days earlier, Buffalo’s bid for a perfect season ended with a 36-28 loss to Boston, and in between that game and the trip to San Diego, the 9-1 team endured some big-time turmoil. Saban cut Cookie Gilchrist because the star fullback had refused to go into the game for a series at the end of the first half, though Saban would say his rash decision was for “a combination of many things. His only concern is himself and how much yardage he gains. We’ve gotten 2 1/2 good seasons from him and we appreciat

item.description: Nov 24, 2026; Las Vegas, Nevada, USA; Tennessee guard Terrence Hill Jr. (3) brings the ball up court against Maryland during the second half of an opening round game of the Players Era Sixteen tournament at Michelob Ultra Arena. Mandatory Credit: Candice Ward-Imagn Images Tennessee has a chance to make another statement on the national stage Thursday. The No. 9 Volunteers will face Iowa State in a rematch of last season’s NCAA Tournament matchup. LAS VEGAS — The Tennessee Volunteers (6-0) will put their undefeated record on the line against the Iowa State Cyclones (4-1) in the Players Era 16 tournament. Tipoff is scheduled for 3:30 p.m. ET at Michelob ULTRA Arena. The game will air nationally on ESPN. Tennessee enters the matchup following a hard-fought 72-64 victory over Maryland. Iowa State also picked up a tournament-opening win, defeating San Diego State 81-68. Both programs have established themselves defensively. Thursday’s matchup could come down to which team finds enough offense against a pair of physical defenses. Tennessee’s Defense Continues to Lead the Way Head coach Rick Barnes has Tennessee playing at a high level early in the season. The Volunteers have held four of their six opponents below 60 points. Their defensive numbers are particularly impressive. Tennessee ranks among the nation’s best in effective field-goal percentage defense and two-point percentage defense, according to KenPom. The Volunteers also delivered one of their biggest wins against then-No. 2 Michigan State. They limited the Spartans to just 46 points in a 61-46 victory. Tennessee’s latest win came against Maryland on Tuesday. Senior guard Dai Dai Ames led the way with 24 points while shooting 9-of-10 from the field. Ames has given the Volunteers another reliable scoring option. Tennessee will need another strong performance from him against Iowa State. Iowa State Presents a Different Kind of Challenge The Cyclones enter Thursday with a 4-1 record and plenty of confidence. Their only loss came against Memphis earlier this month. Iowa State responded with four consecutive victories. Its latest was an 81-68 win over previously unbeaten San Diego State in the opening round. Tre Singleton led all scorers with 22 points against the Aztecs. The Cyclones also forced 18 turnovers and converted those mistakes into 25 points. Head coach T.J. Otzelberger has built his program around defensive pressure. Iowa State has held 23 consecutive opponents below their season scoring averages, excluding season openers. Senior guard Tamin Lipsey remains an important piece of that approach. The fifth-year guard returns to lead the offense and was named to the All-Big 12 preseason team. item.title: Anthony Gordon and Gabriel Jesus offer revealing insights after Barcelona’s emphatic Sabah win: ‘A very special place for me’
item.description: Anthony Gordon and Gabriel Jesus offer revealing insights after Barcelona’s emphatic Sabah win: ‘A very special place for me’ Anthony Gordon continued his remarkable scoring record in Azerbaijan with a brace in Barcelona’s 4-1 Champions League victory over Sabah , while Gabriel Jesus admitted he was dissatisfied with his performance despite finding the net. Notably, the English winger has now scored six goals across his two appearances in Azerbaijan, having previously struck four times against Qarabag in February as a Newcastle United player. Speaking after the match, Gordon was asked whether he considered himself the ‘King of Baku’ , but the winger played down the suggestion while acknowledging the special connection he has developed with the city. “I wouldn’t say that (laughs), but it’s a very special place for me. I should have scored a hat-trick, but I missed that one with my left foot. I’m very happy,” Anthony began. Gordon praises Barcelona’s pressing and attacking approach Despite the comfortable scoreline, Gordon acknowledged that the long journey and time away from his family had made the fixture challenging. He also praised Sabah for their competitiveness. “The last few days haven’t been easy because of the travelling and being away from my family. But we’ve done our job, whilst respecting Sabah – they’re a great team.” He also highlighted Barcelona’s high pressing and attacking intent as key factors behind the victory. “We pressed well high up the pitch, we had our chances and we made the most of them. I’m really pleased to be part of this team. Scoring goals is always our aim; we never stopped attacking – that’s our style.” Anthony Gordon scored twice against Sabah. (Picture credit: Barcelona website) The winger finished by expressing his desire to return to Azerbaijan, stating, “I’d like to go back, yes (laughs). I hope to return soon.” Gabriel Jesus admits Barcelona performance fell short Jesus was also among Barcelona’s scorers , but the Brazilian striker was less satisfied with his individual display. He pointed to the difficulty of playing away from home against a motivated opponent, particularly when the team includes players who have not featured regularly. “The Champions League is always tough, especially against teams like these, who are extra motivated when they play against Barça. “Playing here isn’t easy; on top of that, with changes to the line-up and players who don’t play regularly, it’s difficult for everyone. We won, and I’m very happy with the goal, but not so much with my performance. “I’m the number 9 and I always like to score goals, and I hope to keep working on that.” He also explained why Barcelona took time to find their rhythm, acknowledging that players with limited minutes can find it harder to develop understanding during matches. “When you play with players who aren’t getting much playing time, it’s a bit harder to find solutions during the match. item.title: ESPN’s Alyssa Lang Issues Thanksgiving Warning as Controversial Take Resurfaces
item.description: Dec 4, 2021; Atlanta, GA, USA; Georgia Bulldogs head coach Kirby Smart is interviewed by SEC Network reporter Alyssa Lang prior to the the SEC championship game against the Alabama Crimson Tide at Mercedes-Benz Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Dale Zanine-USA TODAY Sports Credit: USA TODAY Sports (Reuters) COLUMBIA, S.C. — ESPN personality and South Carolina graduate Alyssa Lang has a message for Americans preparing their Thanksgiving dinners. And it might not sit well with everyone gathering around the table Thursday. The longtime SEC Network reporter resurfaced one of her more unconventional holiday opinions Monday, Nov. 23, reminding her social media followers that she is not particularly impressed by Thanksgiving’s traditional centerpiece. Alyssa Lang Revisits Her Thanksgiving Opinion Lang shared a brief reminder on X, drawing attention to a Thanksgiving message she originally published Nov. 26, 2024. In that post, the ESPN personality warned followers against allowing holiday traditions to dictate what they should eat. “Don’t let Big Turkey peer pressure you into eating mediocre meat this Thanksgiving. My column,” Lang wrote. Just a reminder! https://t.co/zw4JWh1bTn — Alyssa Lang (@AlyssaLang) November 23, 2026 The message offered a humorous criticism of turkey, a food that remains synonymous with Thanksgiving celebrations across the country. By revisiting the post just days before this year’s holiday, Lang brought her unconventional opinion back into the conversation. Her original message also illustrates a familiar Thanksgiving debate: whether turkey actually deserves its place as the centerpiece of the holiday meal. A Familiar Face for SEC Football Fans Lang has become one of the most recognizable personalities associated with ESPN’s Southeastern Conference coverage. A 2015 graduate of the University of South Carolina, she began her ESPN career with SEC Network in 2018. She subsequently became a regular presence on SEC Now and other college sports broadcasts, developing a reputation for mixing football analysis with humor and personality. In 2026, Lang expanded her responsibilities by taking on ESPN and ESPN2 college football studio hosting duties. Her connection to the conference remains particularly strong, however, with years of experience covering SEC football, basketball, baseball and softball. Thanksgiving Brings a Different Kind of Debate Lang’s resurfaced post arrives as college football fans prepare for one of the busiest weekends of the season. The SEC’s traditional rivalry games will dominate attention Friday and Saturday, with postseason implications surrounding several matchups. Before those games begin, however, millions of fans will gather for Thanksgiving meals. Some will undoubtedly agree with Lang’s assessment of turkey, while others will defend the holiday tradition. item.description: 0% dribbles, 0% duels won, 0 shots on target: Man United’s Joshua Zirkzee proves once again he is not the answer Manchester United were the architects of their own downfall once again last night. Match The Red Devils gave away two first-half penalties, even if Sporting CP could only score one. They did well, though, to fight back early in the second half and took a 2-1 lead into the closing part of the game. Nonetheless, Senne Lammens managed to make his second costly error of the game when he dropped a looping cross under minimal contact and Luis Suárez scored the rebound. There were some things Pochettino could take solace in, including the away side’s pressing, which looked more active and organised than in previous matches this season. Nonetheless, the form of striker Joshua Zirkzee was not one of them. Joshua Zirkzee struggles The Dutch striker was given his chance to shine with Benjamin Sesko injured and Matheus Cunha suspended for the match. However, the former Bologna striker made no real impact on the match and failed to take his chance. Zirkzee had two shots on goal, both blazing over the bar and not threatening for Sporting keeper. He also tried to dribble the ball forward twice but lost possession on both occasions. Zirkzee made zero key passes and only 70% of his 20 attempts on the evening before being subbed off midway through the second half. He was also a non-factor defensively, as he did not make any tackles or win a single aerial or ground duel during the entire match. With Cunha being available again on Saturday for the Premier League, Zirkzee will likely find himself once again on the bench against Brentford. Joshua Zirkzee Season stats 26/27 Page 1 of 2 1 2

item.title: Bareman Slams Door On Stirling Vs. Ulberg
item.description: AUCKLAND, NEW ZEALAND - NOVEMBER 26: City Kickboxing head trainer Eugene Bareman addresses the media on November 26, 2026 in Auckland, New Zealand in relation to fighters Navajo Stirling (L) and Carlos Ulberg (R) who both train together out of the Auckland based gym. (Photo by Dean Purcell/New Zealand Herald via Getty Images) Surging Light Heavyweight knockout artist Navajo Stirling has earned a UFC title shot … if he wants it. The 29-year-old Kiwi won four bouts this year, extending his undefeated record to 12-0 with seven of those victories coming inside the Octagon. Not only is Stirling winning, but he’s knocking out opponents left and right, including a pair of former champions in Jan Blachowicz and Jiri Prochazka (watch here) . Young and hungry, he’s clearly the most deserving 205-pound contender at the moment. Unfortunately, his teammate Carlos Ulberg already holds the crown. After stopping “BJP,” Stirling sounded hesitant to face his training partner, who also knocked out Prochazka earlier this year. However, the door was at least still open to some degree. City Kickboxing head coach, Eugene Bareman, made a public address with the clear intention of shutting down these conversations. Flanked by both Stirling and Ulberg, Bareman resolutely declared that City Kickboxing athletes will never fight one another. “The status at the moment is, and it’s been like this forever, is the boys from the same gym don’t fight,” Bareman explained (via Yahoo ). “We’ve had that agreement from the very onset of this gym when it first started, that if you join this team, you’ve got to commit to not fighting each other. Both the boys have known that. Both the boys are in agreement with that. They’ve been in agreement with the start.” Bareman added, “It was never even contemplated.” What makes City Kickboxing such a tight knit group? After all, we’ve seen training partners splinter off and fight previously when the title is on the line. Per Bareman, that’s a result of geography and the available nearby options, which force the Kiwi fighters to stick together and bond. “We’re a tiny nation and a tiny gym, and our environment’s very special,” Bareman said. “Like, it’s very tight-knit. For instance, I might be speaking out of turn here, but you’ve got like Gilbert Burns and Kamaru Usman who came from the same team and fought each other. Now, and again, I could be speaking out of turn, but I guess the difference is like a lot of those American gyms, guys come in, and they do their eight weeks, and then they go back to their home country. And then they come in and do their eight weeks. So you might see a guy two times a year for eight weeks. “You’re not going to form a bond with him. You’re not going to get to know his family. You’re not going to get to know everything about him. There’s going to be any chance for a friendship to be formed.” Unfortunately, this is a significant sacrifice being asked of Stirling. item.title: Bayern Munich’s Max Eberl does not rule out January transfers after disaster loss to LOSC Lille
item.description: LILLE, FRANCE - NOVEMBER 25: Vincent Kompany, Manager of FC Bayern Munich, talks in a flash interview after the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD5 match between LOSC Lille and FC Bayern München at Stade Pierre Mauroy on November 25, 2026 in Lille, France. (Photo by Alexander Hassenstein - UEFA/UEFA via Getty Images) | UEFA via Getty Images Bayern Munich’s injury list sees worry spread through the club. The vast majority of the club’s attacking players are either half fit or out for months, meaning the state of the squad looks less than ide al, to say the least, heading into the final six games of 2026. Having just lost for the first time this season against Lille OSC in the Champions League, the ur ge to try and fix things through transfers can be felt spreading through the fandom. But Bayern wi ll not panic. Bayern’s board member fo r sport, Max Eberl, highlights that the club does not want to mak e hasty decisions: “First of all, what’s decisive is how the squad will look in January,” he noted clearly after the Lille match (as captured by @iMiaSanMia ). “We won’t make any knee-jerk decisions. We know the quality we have on this team. The players showed that in the first half, and I want to emphasize that again: the team showed its quality in the first half. We didn’t quite manage to do the same in the second half. Some players will return, and then we can assess things calmly.” Eberl’s response became more interesting, however, when the reporter suggested the exact opposite: that Bayern want to avoid the January transfer window altogether. “I think that’s a bit of an oversimplification,” the former Borussi a Mönchengladbach sporting director explained. “We signed Jonas Urbig in the winter as well, and I don’t think that was a bad January signing. There are definitely opportunitie s out there. But any potential signing would have to be a perfect fit. If we do consider mak ing a move, we’ll assess the situation calmly.” Join the conversation! item.title: Roma star personally urges Real Madrid youngster to join Italian side in January: ‘Come, come’
item.description: Roma star personally urges Real Madrid youngster to join Italian side in January: ‘Come, come’ Real Madrid face a difficult decision in the January transfer window regarding the future of talented Brazilian youngster Endrick. The 20-year-old is widely regarded as one of the biggest attacking talents of his generation, but opportunities in the Spanish capital have been few and far between. Despite manager Jose Mourinho repeatedly expressing his full confidence in Endrick’s abilities, the lack of minutes is making it difficult to justify those words. Interest from European clubs is certainly not a problem for Endrick. Ahead of January, Italian clubs are keeping a close eye . Wesley confirms attempts to convince Endrick Now, AS Roma defender and international teammate Wesley has admitted that he has already spoken to Endrick about joining Roma. Speaking to TNT Sports after the Serie A side’s impressive 2-2 Champions League draw against PSG, Wesley admitted that Roma would love to sign the Los Blancos starlet. Wesley Franca wants Endrick at Roma. (Photo by Timothy Rogers/Getty Images) “I gave him a little nudge. I told him, ‘Come, come,’ but he’s the one who decides. It’s his career,” the defender explained. The Brazilian also made it clear that Endrick would receive a warm welcome should he eventually decide to join Roma. “I hope that wherever he goes, or if he stays at Real Madrid, he is very happy and successful because he’s a good kid who deserves it.” “If he comes, he’ll certainly be very well received by Roma’s supporters and by us,” Wesley added. Mourinho remains reluctant to sanction a departure Roma’s interest in the 20-year-old is not exactly new, with the Italian club having previously explored a loan move for him. However, securing his signature in January could prove difficult. Mourinho remains firmly opposed to the idea of Endrick leaving mid-season. Endrick is unable to get regular minutes at Real Madrid. (Photo by David Balogh/Getty Images) The Portuguese manager has always maintained that he believes Endrick could have a much more prominent role to play in the latter part of the season. However, with Carlos Espi ahead of him in the striker pecking order and the Spaniard himself struggling for minutes, the situation doesn’t look great for Endrick. If Real Madrid ultimately decide to let Endrick leave, it’s likely to be on a loan deal similar to the one with Olympique Lyon back in January. Endrick still has a lot of potential and the talent to succeed at the Spanish club, and it remains to be seen what decision the club makes in the winter transfer window.

item.title: Kenny Smith makes Luka Doncic point to stress what LeBron James does to put ‘NBA in danger’
item.description: Photo by Mitchell Leff/Getty Images LeBron James has turned over a new leaf in his NBA career by leaving behind Luka Doncic and the Lakers, but Kenny Smith says what he keeps doing has put the NBA in danger. Both Luka Doncic and LeBron James are enjoying their time in the NBA despite going their separate ways with the Philadelphia 76ers and the Los Angeles Lakers. James is turning back Father Time, while Doncic is relishing added responsibilities with the Lakers and thriving with it. After James’ latest triple-double in the 76ers’ victory, Kenny Smith made a Doncic point to stress that what James is doing puts the “NBA in danger”. Kenny Smith on LeBron James The 76ers beat the Miami Heat in the NBA Cup group stage, and James reminded everyone that he’s still a force to be reckoned with at age 41. He put up 25 points, 10 rebounds, and 12 assists, finally finding his 3PT range in the process as well, to finish with the highest +/- among all the starters. Smith, speaking on Inside the NBA , said after the game that people shouldn’t be surprised at what James keeps doing, because he did it last season as well. Smith said that when Doncic was missing for the Lakers, James easily flipped the switch from creator to scorer, and the ability to do that means the NBA is still not over the danger of James’ domination. He said: “We can’t forget, without Luka, he dominated the first round of the series in the playoffs last season. The game is parallel today, so you’re a track star. He pushes the ball like that. He’s still 6’9”, 240 lbs, and moves at a track pace. “The NBA is still in danger with him on the court.” The Heat got a first-hand glimpse at what a fully locked-in James can still do, because he’s told everyone he was never declining. James just manages his minutes and picks and chooses when to go full-tilt, and when he does, it’s game over for the opposition. To have that kind of an impact on a winning team that is a championship contender is a remarkable ode to his fitness and professionalism. item.title: Four-time MVP Rodgers released and may have played last NFL game
item.description: Aaron Rodgers has thrown 16 touchdown passes and six interceptions from 10 games this season [Getty Images] Veteran quarterback Aaron Rodgers may have played his last game in the NFL after being released by the Pittsburgh Steelers. In a brief statement published on Wednesday afternoon local time, the Steelers announced Rodgers, the NFL's four-time Most Valuable Player, was no longer with the franchise. That came after a tumultuous 24 hours, which began with the Steelers announcing at 23:10 local time on Tuesday that Rodgers had been replaced as their starting quarterback. He then appeared on US sports TV programme the Pat McAfee Show on Wednesday, saying he would not rejoin the team. "That ship has sailed," said Rodgers, who turns 43 next week. During the 34-minute interview, he was critical of Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy, including accusing him of snoring while he slept through team meetings. They won the Super Bowl together with the Green Bay Packers in 2011 and, during Sunday's loss to the Philadelphia Eagles, Rodgers claims that McCarthy ended the half-time huddle with a chant of "one, two, three, Packers". McCarthy, 63, was in charge for most of Rodgers' 18-year spell with the Packers and left in 2018. He then coached the Dallas Cowboys from 2020-2024. Tension had developed between the pair over play-calling and Rodgers says he told McCarthy "try to bench me or don't change the play-caller, then you should just release me". Shortly before Pittsburgh confirmed his release, McCarthy responded to Rodgers' interview, telling reporters "there was an ultimatum made that was clearly outside his job description", adding it was his decision to let the player go. All this came after the Steelers said that Mason Rudolph will start Friday's home game against the Denver Broncos and that Rodgers would be inactive, so would not serve as back-up to the 31-year-old. Rodgers, who joined Pittsburgh in 2025 after two years with the New York Jets, was "99% sure" he was going to retire after leading the Steelers to last season's play-offs. McCarthy's appointment persuaded him to play one more year but Rodgers told the talk show on Wednesday the season had not been "what I signed up for". Although the Steelers have a 6-4 record, they have had two straight defeats after losing 19-16 at Philadelphia on Sunday. Analysis - an unceremonious end to an illustrious career? Pittsburgh's brief statement confirming Rodgers' release is likely the unceremonious end to an illustrious career. While Rodgers was unable to claim a second Super Bowl win with Green Bay, he was named the season MVP in 2011, 2014, 2020 and 2021. Only Peyton Manning (five) has won the award more times. Rodgers had said his 22nd year in the NFL would be his last, and he has been let go at a crucial stage in the season. The Cincinnati Bengals (7-3) lead the AFC North division, with Pittsburgh third, but with seven games left the Steelers occupy the final play-off spot for the AFC Conference. Althoug

item.title: 'I wouldn't like to face them again!' - Luis Enrique stunned after AS Roma end PSG's 12-game winning run
item.description: FBL-FRA-LIGUE1-NICE-PSG - AFP Luis Enrique admitted AS Roma handed Paris Saint-Germain their toughest test of the season after Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw snapped PSG's 12-game winning streak. Following Donyell Malen's late penalty, the Spanish coach lavished praise on Gian Piero Gasperini and even tipped the Italian side to win the Scudetto. Roma end PSG's 12-game winning streak Enrique praised Roma for delivering his side's toughest test of the season after Wednesday's 2-2 Champions League draw . The result snapped PSG's impressive 12-game winning streak across all competitions. Roma striker Malen secured a share of the points in the 78th minute, blasting home a decisive penalty. It marked the first time PSG had dropped points since losing at home to Monaco on September 4. Enrique hails Roma's mentality and attitude Rather than dwelling on the end of his team's dominant run, Enrique was quick to credit the visitors for pushing his players to their limits. "Without any doubt this was our toughest match of this season, in the Champions League or the French league," Enrique said, as quoted by ESPN . "I am happy with the result, and the merit goes to Roma. Facing a team with this attitude and this kind of mentality is very hard to play against. It's very different to the kind of match we're used to." Respect for Gasperini's tactical setup Wednesday's clash also marked the first time Enrique had gone head-to-head with Roma boss Gasperini in the dugout. The Spaniard paused and nodded in respect when discussing his counterpart's tactical setup. "It's the first time I've come up against him as a coach," Luis Enrique said. "It's better to talk about Roma's future, not PSG's. Roma's future is wonderful, they can win the Scudetto. I have no doubt they can finish in the top 24, I hope so, and I wouldn't like to face them again. Maybe in the final." Champions League league phase standings and outlook The draw leaves PSG's position in the Champions League league phase unchanged. They remain second in the table with 13 points from five matches, sitting two points behind leaders Real Madrid. Roma, meanwhile, sit 25th with five points, leaving them with work to do to climb into the qualification places.

item.title: Knee surgery rules Sinner out of Australian Open
item.description: Jannik Sinner is a five-time Grand Slam champion [Getty Images] Jannik Sinner has been ruled out of the Australian Open in January following an operation on his knee. The 25-year-old Italian, who won the 2024 and 2025 titles at Melbourne Park, has not played competitively since winning Wimbledon on 12 July. In a social media post on Tuesday, world number two Sinner said he had undergone surgery to "improve the condition of my iliotibial band" - a thick band of tissue that runs along the outside of the knee. "We've been in regular touch with Jannik's team and they've confirmed he won't be joining us for the AO [Australian Open] in January following his recent surgery," said Tennis Australia chief executive Andrew Abdo. "Jannik loves competing here in Melbourne and is looking forward to returning for AO 2028. We wish him all the very best with his recovery and look forward to seeing him back on court soon." The 2027 Australian Open main draw starts on 17 January. Sinner's challenge at the 2026 tournament was ended by a five-set semi-final defeat by Novak Djokovic. Sinner was the dominant player for the first half of the season, winning 44 and losing just three of his singles matches. He won five Masters 1000 titles in a row between March and May, becoming the youngest man to complete the 'career Golden Masters', and reclaimed the world's top ranking from Alcaraz along the way. However, he suffered a shock second-round exit at the French Open, with Zverev ultimately stepping up to win his first Grand Slam title. Sinner bounced back on the grass courts, demolishing Novak Djokovic in the semi-finals before coming back from a set down against Zverev in the Wimbledon showpiece. He ended his season in early October, meaning he was unable to defend the points he claimed with title triumphs in China, Vienna, Paris and the ATP Finals at the end of 2025. Zverev went on to win the US Open and secure the year-end number one ranking. item.title: Tom Brady explains what makes Brock Purdy stand out after 49ers star’s latest masterclass
item.description: Photo by Michael Owens/Getty Images Tom Brady has explained what makes Brock Purdy so impressive after the San Francisco 49ers quarterback delivered another outstanding performance in the win over the Minnesota Vikings. Purdy threw three touchdown passes in the first half as the 49ers cruised to a 35-10 victory, strengthening their position at the top of the NFC. The quarterback was subsequently named NFC Offensive Player of the Week for the fourth time in his career and has emerged as a slight favourite for the MVP award heading into Week 12. Tom Brady praises Brock Purdy’s decision-making and speed Brady, who will be calling the 49ers’ upcoming clash with the Seattle Seahawks for FOX Sports , believes Purdy is operating at a level that separates him from the rest of the league. Speaking about the San Francisco quarterback, the seven-time Super Bowl champion highlighted his ability to process information quickly and make decisions under pressure. “He’s just operating a lot faster than everybody else,” Brady said. “Some guys are operating at 1.0. Some guys are operating at 1.5. Brock’s operating at 2.0 right now. He’s thinking fast. He’s making fast decisions. The ball’s coming out of his hands quickly.” Brady then used a podcast comparison to explain his point, suggesting Purdy is getting far more done because of how quickly he processes the game. The numbers certainly support the praise. Purdy has completed 71 per cent of his passes for 2,564 yards and 23 touchdowns across 10 starts this season. His passing yardage ranks ninth in the NFL while his touchdown total is the third-highest in the league. San Francisco have also won nine of their first 10 games. However, there is a fitness concern ahead of the Seahawks matchup. Purdy appeared on the injury report with an ankle issue sustained against Minnesota and did not practise, with head coach Kyle Shanahan describing him as day-to-day. Shanahan confirmed it was not a high ankle sprain, but his availability remains a key talking point. If Purdy cannot play, Mac Jones would be in line to start for the 49ers. item.title: Double boost for Matthias Jaissle on Newcastle United injury and fitness front
item.description: Matthias Jaissle Matthias Jaissle hadn’t had the best of luck when it comes to injuries with his Newcastle United squad. However, for the Arsenal match last weekend it looked like the treatment/recovery room was almost cleared. Ewen Jaouen and Joelinton appearing to be the only senior players unable to be considered for the match against the league leaders, with Matthias Jaissle appearing to omit Aladji Bamba and Bazoumana Toure purely by choice, with others favoured. So after getting to that point of all but clearing the treatment room out and on the back of such a positive second half performance and excellent result against Arsenal, the last thing the United boss needed was to see any new injuries. Just as an absorbing Arsenal game had gone into the nine minutes of added time, Lewis Hall was left limping after he had blocked a cross and tried to carry on, was then having to limp off a minute or so later and be replaced by Sven Botman. Following the match, Matthias Jaissle asked whether Lewis Hall was now an injury worry: “Hopefully it is only just a cramp that meant Lewis Hall had to come off. That is what we are hoping.” Newcastle United have now posted clips from the training ground ahead of the Brighton match and the great news is that they show Lewis Hall sprinting out with the rest of the first team squad for group training, clearly no lasting impact from Saturday and Jaissle’s cramp diagnosis/hope proved correct. There is also other good news on the injury and fitness front. It was feared that Joelinton would be out for a considerable time when suffering a muscle injury during the home defeat to Everton in early November. However, a new media exclusive from The Mail has now reported that their inside sources have informed them that the prognosis isn’t as bad as had first been feared and that Joelinton is now expected to full training next week, ahead of the Man U and Sunderland matches at St James’ Park. You would assume Man U is almost certainly too early but if he doesn’t have any setbacks, it sounds very much like a chance the Brazil international could potentially feature against the mackems. Not that there were any fears raised about him after the weekend but it’s still great to see Tino Livramento heavily involved in the training footage released by the club on Wednesday. He reminded us against Arsenal just how good he can be and a huge boost for everyone if he can now stay fit and be in the kind of form he showed on Saturday. Matthias Jaissle was asked about the right-back after the Arsenal match: “Tino can definitely give us another dimension to our play but we also have to be careful and smart. He was really on the limit of what he could do. I was really proud that he could deliver 45 minutes with that physicality in such an intense match. It was really well played, a top performance, and also something that he can build on.” A huge eight days of matches coming up and Matthias Jaissle needs as many of his key players as possible

item.title: Jalen Green Criticizes Officiating And Rockets’ Flopping But Says Suns Needed The Reality Check
item.description: Nov 25, 2026; Houston, Texas, USA; Phoenix Suns guard Jalen Green (4) handles the ball against Houston Rockets guard Fred VanVleet (5) during the third quarter at Toyota Center. Mandatory Credit: Erik Williams-Imagn Images Jalen Green received a warm welcome back to Houston, the city where he ended up getting drafted, as the Rockets faced the Suns tonight in the NBA Cup. The Rockets ended up defeating the Suns 116-104 on a historic night for Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun as well . The former Rockets player struggled to find his rhythm tonight and ended the game with 16 points, five assists, and four rebounds while shooting 8-21 from the field (38.1% FG) and missing all four of his three-point shot attempts. While reflecting on the loss after the game, Jalen Green spoke to the Suns’ media in the locker room scrum, where he called out the officials for seeming to fall for the Rockets’ flopping consistently throughout the night. “That was the one that we really needed overall. A top team in the West. We’ve got to be able to come out and play aggressive. Had some lapses on the offensive side,” Jalen Green said . “But overall, the refs were calling all these flops and things like that, kind of f–ked the game up… All that flopping needs to be called; it’s what’s been happening. But they didn’t call it flopping even one time,” Green added. Even the Suns’ player Oso Ighodaro, who fouled out of tonight’s game late after chucking Alperen Sengun , also echoed the same sentiment as Jalen Green. “That’s how they called it from the jump,” Ighodaro said about the physicality he expected from the Rockets. “Umm. Yeah. Refs were calling a lot of stuff, a lot of flopping. Just got to be smarter.” Hence, Jalen Green and the Suns players seem to commonly believe that officiating partly spoiled not just Green’s homecoming game, but also their hopes of proceeding ahead in the NBA Cup. But Green did not hold the loss to his heart and greeted all his former teammates after the final buzzer. “That’s love. I was here for four years. The fans have always been great to me. Houston always got a special place in my heart,” Green concluded with a message for his former team, showing him love with the introduction video tonight. good to have Jalen back in the building! 🤝 — Houston Rockets (@HoustonRockets) November 26, 2026 The Suns have fallen to 9-8 for the season and will now face the Mavericks on Friday, November 27. They have ended this five-game road trip with a 4-1 record before heading home now. Meanwhile, the Rockets have improved to 14-5, and they now face the 76ers on Saturday, November 28. These two sides will face each other once again on February 5 in Phoenix. One can certainly chalk it up as one of the most intense matchups to look forward to in the coming season. It will be interesting to see how Jalen Green hopes to get his revenge on his former team in that game for tonight’s loss.

item.title: Frustration reigns for Pochettino in chaotic start to Man Utd job
item.description: Two games, no wins. Two red cards, two goals scored. One goal disallowed, six conceded. Is it possible for Mauricio Pochettino to have learned anything from a crazy first week as Manchester United boss? United and Pochettino went on the warpath before the Champions League encounter with Sporting, furious at Leny Yoro's dismissal at Liverpool which they believe was unjust and shaped the eventual 4-0 defeat. Club officials were seething after the 2-2 draw in Lisbon as well. This time it was 2022 World Cup final referee Szymon Marciniak in the firing line. Blowing before Amad's first-half header went into the net meant VAR had no chance to assess whether the Polish official was right to rule Youri Tielemans had fouled Goncalo Inacio before prodding the ball through to the Ivorian. Former United winger Ashley Young didn't think so. He called Marciniak's performance "a disgrace". That Tielemans picked up a booking that eventually led to his late red card – the Old Trafford outfit have now had four players sent off in their past five games, meaning the Belgian will miss the Old Trafford clash with RB Leipzig on 8 December - just compounded the situation. Then, in a matter of minutes, Marciniak decided neither Manchester United keeper Senne Lammens nor Sporting counterpart Kaique had been fouled as they conceded. Their respective defences complained bitterly. Marciniak was only asked to go to the pitchside monitor by VAR for the latter incident, which he overturned. United insiders felt the Tielemans incident was clearly not a foul and Amad's goal should have stood. They also felt any foul on Kaique by Patrick Dorgu was marginal and did not warrant their goal being disallowed. Pochettino trod a fine path, knowing if he said something too controversial, it could land him with a fine. A nod of a head in agreement was his initial reaction in his post-match news conference, when asked if he felt Marciniak had got it wrong. A few minutes before, he was more expansive when he spoke to TNT. "It's difficult to find a game where you get punished [so much] in one game," he said. "We were punished a lot in key actions." The goals they conceded at the Jose Alvalade were bizarre. Seventy-five seconds after superbly saving one penalty, goalkeeper Lammens suffered a rush of blood and conceded another, which was scored. Lammens was at fault for the second, when he dropped the ball into the path of Sporting striker Luis Suarez, who scored with an overhead kick. item.title: Divots, howlers and bad decisions - dissecting Man Utd's draw in Lisbon
item.description: Manchester United were held to a draw in a chaotic and controversial Champions League encounter with Sporting in Lisbon with Mauricio Pochettino denied a first win as United head coach despite his side turning around a first-half deficit. They were behind at the break after goalkeeper Senne Lammens conceded from a penalty he gave away – having saved another just minutes before. United then had a goal disallowed before scoring a penalty of their own through Bruno Fernandes, who then put them in front with the help of a large divot on the pitch. Fernandes appeared to have inadvertently created the divot himself moments earlier when turning in the penalty area. There was more drama as Lammens dropped the ball for Sporting's equaliser before Pochettino's side had what they thought was a winner ruled out. Polish referee Szymon Marciniak was at the centre of much of the drama with midfielder Youri Tielemans sent off in stoppage time. BBC Sport breaks down each incident after a crazy night. Lammens saves penalty (30 mins) Lammens saved a poor penalty from Sporting's Luis Suarez, given after Lisandro Martinez left a leg out which caught Geny Catamo. The Belgium keeper got down to hold on to Suarez's low effort which looked set to be a huge boost for the underperforming United number one. Suarez scored the second from the spot [Getty Images] Pochettino's whirlwind week ends with optimism and frustration Sporting score second penalty (31 mins) Lammens went from hero to zero in the space of 76 seconds as he rushed out of his goal and took out Maxi Araujo in the United box. Noussair Mazraoui was caught out by a ball over the top but it was reckless from Lammens and this time Suarez buried the spot-kick. Former United midfielder Owen Hargreaves told TNT Sports: "There is no way Senne Lammens can get there. Just stay in the goal." United 'goal' ruled out (40 mins) Amad Diallo thought he had equalised for United before half-time when he headed in after his first attempted was turned on to the cross bar. However, referee Marciniak blew his whistle for a foul against Youri Tielemans. Replays showed Tielemans won the ball and pulled out of the challenge after he played the ball through to Amad. BBC Sport's Dale Johnson: "Marciniak believed that Goncalo Inacio had been fouled by Youri Tielemens on the edge of the area as the Manchester United midfielder played a pass through. "Rather than immediately blow his whistle, Marciniak held off to let the move play out. "But when Diallo hit the bar with his first effort, Marciniak blew his whistle. "Play was dead at that point, so when Diallo then nodded the rebound over the line the VAR was locked out. "However, the chances that the VAR would have intervened were very slim. "Tielemens, who was booked, caught Inacio's foot under his body sliding to make the pass, causing the Sporting defender's ankle to buckle." item.title: T. J. Houshmandzadeh sides with Aaron Rodgers over Steelers HC Mike McCarthy
item.description: Barry Reeger-Imagn Images. T. J. Houshmandzadeh sides with Aaron Rodgers over Steelers HC Mike McCarthy appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Pittsburgh Steelers fans are perhaps still trying to process everything that has unfolded within the organization. Within just one day, the team went from Aaron Rodgers being its starting quarterback to handing the reins to Mason Rudolph . The strained relationship between Rodgers and Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy has emerged as a major factor behind the unexpected developments. However, former NFL player T.J. Houshmandzadeh has come to the defense of the former Steelers quarterback. During an appearance on Speakeasy, Houshmandzadeh criticized the Steelers’ coaching staff, including McCarthy, as well as general manager Omar Khan, for the way they handled Rodgers’ situation. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “All the people, and I hope y’all know not all the people we gonna see that are not on Aaron Rodgers’ side, they’re biased. If you try to flame Aaron Rodgers for this, you are biased. The people on television, you’re biased. You don’t like them. You have an agenda because there’s no way you’re benching me for Mason Rudolph after Mason Rudolph was on the team when you brought me in. You brought me back this year.” The former NFL player then shifted his attention toward McCarthy, backing Rodgers’ allegations against his longtime head coach during his appearance on The Pat McAfee Show. “Mike McCarthy, you sleeping and beating, and you think I’m not gonna say that?” he added. “Mike McCarthy, you break us down 123 Steelers or Packers. You think I’m not gonna say that? Mike McCarthy, you ain’t watching film leading up to the game; you ain’t showing up for walkthrough. You think I’m not gonna say that?” The Steelers’ decision marks a disappointing ending to Rodgers’ second season in Pittsburgh. The four-time NFL MVP returned for another year hoping to make a final push toward a Super Bowl, but everything ended the way no one wanted. Rodgers had previously indicated that the 2026 season would be his final NFL season. Now, with his Steelers tenure officially over, questions surrounding his football future have become even more significant. Meanwhile, the Steelers are preparing to face the Denver Broncos with Rudolph taking over as their starting quarterback.
